# Limitless Snow Removal | Landing (staging)

Generated by `scripts/export-live-landing-manual.mjs` from `app-templates/customer-portal/cms/granite-ridge-snow.landing-staging.json`. Never hand-edit this directory.

| field | value |
| --- | --- |
| template code | `CUSTOMER_PORTAL_GRANITE_RIDGE_LANDING_STAGING` |
| template language | `JTE` |
| children | none: one root template renders every section |
| robots | `noindex,nofollow` |
| launch state | `staging-only` |
| sections | `public-nav`, `reason-notice`, `hero`, `services`, `how-it-works`, `service-area`, `faq`, `final-cta`, `footer` |

## Destinations

| parameter | value |
| --- | --- |
| `LANDING_URL` | `https://dev-1.servicewand.com/pages/SNOWLIMITLESS/home` |
| `REQUEST_QUOTE_URL` | `https://dev-1.servicewand.com/pages/SNOWLIMITLESS/request-quote` |
| `SIGN_IN_URL` | `https://dev-1.servicewand.com/pages/SNOWLIMITLESS/portal#/login` |

## Reason notices

| address ends with | notice |
| --- | --- |
| `?portal=signed-out` | You've signed out. |
| `?portal=no-access` | This account doesn't have access to the customer portal. |

Any other value, and any address with another parameter, shows no notice. Without JavaScript no notice shows. A shown notice removes the parameter from the address.

## Upload

`scripts/upsert-granite-ridge-staging-landing.mjs` rebuilds this package, runs `granite-ridge-staging-landing-manual-check.mjs` and creates or updates the BlockTemplate by code through `app-templates/landing-page/scripts/upload-cms-family.mjs`. It is a dry run unless `--live` is passed, and it never creates or changes a PageContext.

For a manual paste, copy `root/head.html`, `root/html.html`, `root/css.css` and `root/javascript.js` into the matching fields of a JTE BlockTemplate with code `CUSTOMER_PORTAL_GRANITE_RIDGE_LANDING_STAGING`, and declare the parameters of `root/parameters.json`. `root/template.json` is the complete record.

`preview.html` is the document CMS renders: the head, then the stylesheet and the script ahead of the markup in the body.

## Constraints

- The page is public and anonymous: no block calls a backend, reads a session or shows customer, account, order or payment data.
- Every destination is an absolute https address on dev-1.servicewand.com: this landing, the quote form, and the sign-in address portal#/login.
- Only the two reason values the portal sends show a notice: ?portal=signed-out and ?portal=no-access. The notice text is CMS copy; any other value or any extra parameter shows nothing, and without JavaScript no notice shows.
- The copy states only what the tenant's quotation flow does. It carries no reviews, ratings, customer counts, years in business, certifications, guarantees, response times, phone numbers, email addresses, street addresses or prices.
- Every parameter ships a value, because CMS creates no PageContext for a template with an empty parameter. A destination holding the # placeholder is read as not set, and its links are disabled.
- The page emits noindex,nofollow while the tenant is on staging.
